title: Side Panel Focus Highlight Styling
description: When the cursor is inside a side panel, only the outmost rectangle should emphasize and not the border below the tabs.
summary: Fixed wgpu gis2d map tiles not rendering (only pins/labels visible): added startGisMapTileProxyServer() reusing existing OSM/VT Connect middlewares from ui/styling/vite-elements-assets.ts; GIS_MAP_WGPU_TILE_PROXY_PORT=6141 in repo/lib/js; Trunk.toml [[proxy]] forwards /osm/ and /vt/ to the tile proxy; wgpu script.ts starts the proxy for gis2d trunk serve and native-bin (SEMIO_GIS_MAP_TILE_BASE_URL); gis2d plugin render_canvas applies absolute tile URL templates from env for native. Verified: tile proxy returns 200 for osm+vt, gis2d-plugin 15/15 tests pass.
